name: University of South Carolina
description: The University of South Carolina is a public research university with seven satellite campuses throughout the state and a main campus covering over 359 acres in downtown Columbia. Founded in 1801, Columbia is the flagship institution of the University of South Carolina System and offers more than 350 programs of study, leading to bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees from 14 degree-granting colleges and schools.
